description: Evaluation cases for the aws-deep-research skill. Covers strategy selection, multi-source synthesis, report quality, and edge cases.

evals.name: comprehensive-multi-source
evals.prompt: deep research on configuring hierarchical indexing in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless — parent-child relationships, nested fields, efficient query mappings
expected_behavior: Selects 'comprehensive' strategy with intents: service-overview, architecture, best-practices
Dispatches at least 3 subagents in parallel (aws-docs-researcher, web-researcher, and one of blog-feed/github)
Produces report.md with Executive Summary, Detailed Findings, Recommendations, References sections
All references use [N] [Title](url) clickable markdown format
Report contains concrete mapping examples (JSON code blocks)
Report is between 8,000–15,000 chars

evals.name: feed-only-latest-posts
evals.prompt: show me the top 5 latest AWS security blog posts
expected_behavior: Selects 'feed-only' strategy
Dispatches only blog-feed-researcher (no decomposition step)
Maps to 'security' blog category feed URL
Output lists 5 blog posts with titles, dates, and URLs
Does NOT dispatch aws-docs-researcher or web-researcher

evals.name: pricing-focused
evals.prompt: how much does Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 cost compared to provisioned Aurora? Include ACU pricing, storage, I/O costs across regions
expected_behavior: Selects 'pricing-focused' strategy with intent: pricing
Dispatches aws-pricing-researcher and aws-docs-researcher
Report includes pricing tables with specific dollar amounts
Report compares Serverless v2 vs provisioned pricing dimensions
Citations include pricing query dates

evals.name: docs-only-single-service
evals.prompt: what is the maximum number of knowledge bases you can create per account in Amazon Bedrock?
expected_behavior: Selects 'docs-only' strategy
Dispatches only aws-docs-researcher with 2-3 focused subqueries
Report answers the specific quota question with a concrete number
Report cites AWS documentation URL for the quota/limit
Does NOT dispatch web-researcher or blog-feed-researcher

evals.name: comprehensive-with-code-examples
evals.prompt: research how to build a custom DevOps agent using Amazon Bedrock Agent Core with tool definitions, custom workflows, and deployment patterns
expected_behavior: Selects 'comprehensive' strategy with intents: architecture, code-examples
Dispatches github-researcher in addition to aws-docs-researcher
Report includes code examples or references to sample repositories
Report covers Agent Core tool definitions and workflow configuration
At least 10 citations from diverse sources

evals.name: missing-api-keys-graceful
evals.prompt: compare AWS Lambda cold start times across runtimes — Node.js, Python, Java, .NET — with community benchmarks
expected_behavior: Selects 'comprehensive' strategy with intents: comparison, best-practices
If web search keys are missing, informs user and asks to proceed
If user proceeds without web search, still produces a report from AWS docs and blogs
Report notes the gap in Gaps & Limitations section
Does not fail or error — degrades gracefully

evals.name: ambiguous-non-aws-topic
evals.prompt: what are the best vector databases for production use?
expected_behavior: Recognizes this as AWS-adjacent (cloud infrastructure topic)
Activates the skill and frames research with AWS context (OpenSearch, Aurora pgvector, etc.)
Dispatches web-researcher for third-party comparisons (Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
Report covers both AWS-native and third-party options
If skill does NOT activate, that is also acceptable — the description says 'AWS-related topic'

evals.name: output-discipline-context-budget
evals.prompt: deep research on Amazon S3 Express One Zone vs standard S3 — performance, pricing, use cases
expected_behavior: All subagent return text is minimal (one-line '✅ Wrote N chars to <path>')
Synthesizer returns two-line response only
Parent does NOT read raw research files — only report.md
Total subagent return text to parent is under 500 chars combined
Report is coherent despite parent never seeing raw research data
